reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing notification and experience customization tool: it plays sounds on specific DSH agent interaction events and provides chat/theme appearance controls, while also supporting local media uploads for those custom sounds and background assets.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web 提供可配置的事件提示音（提问、审批、任务完成）与聊天界面个性化能力，可设置聊天/侧边栏背景、遮罩和音效参数。
summaries.en: This DSH web plugin adds configurable event-based notification sounds for interactions and lets users customize chat visuals with background color/image and overlay settings.

capabilities: Configurable sound notifications for chat/agent event triggers
Custom visual theming of chat and sidebar via background colors, images, and overlays
Local upload and serving of plugin assets (audio/image) through web endpoints

reasons.code: README describes per-event notification sounds for question/approval/task-completion with configurable effect, volume, repeat count, interval, and mute options.
README details UI personalization settings for background color/image, global and sidebar masks, and reset-to-default behavior in the web panel.
README documents a host service endpoint for uploads and file serving (`/plugins/sound-notify/upload`, `/plugins/sound-notify/files/*`) storing files under `$DSH_HOME/sound-notify/`.
package.json declares a web plugin client and host entry with settings/webServer usage, indicating runtime behavior spans both backend and browser layers.
